decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans, as set out in the attached schedule which forms part of this notice. Site Location Plan 26.11.2025, TOG 02P RevA Dec2025, TOG 02P Oct 2025, SuDS Prop Forma.Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

Notwithstanding the plans hereby approved, the first floor side window shall be obscure glazed, and all new external finishes shall be in materials to match those of the exterior of the existing building.Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.

Notwithstanding the plans hereby approved, prior to any above ground construction works a revised front elevation drawing shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The revised drawing shall provide full details demonstrating that the proposed front elevation closely reflects the existing architectural detailing of the property.Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.
description: Part single, part two-storey side/rear extension with rear dormer, front rooflights, involving demolition of existing rear extension and garage.
